reason: Conversation 1 refuses to engage at all, offering no reassurance or diagnosis and pushing a needless engineer visit for what is normal skin-condenser warmth. Conversation 2 correctly explains side-wall condenser heat, asks the right hazard-ruling questions (smell, scorching, temperatures, hand-on-side test), respects the refusal to pull the unit out, and sets the correct stop-and-unplug boundary. Its flaws are a stray and contradictory 'switch it off and unplug it' line in the second turn (promptly walked back when challenged), slightly overstated concern about the 1cm gap, and an irrelevant 'not cooling' image, but it still served the homeowner far better.
